OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (12 Sep 45) CS
(SCAPIN - 20)
APO 500
12 September 1945
MEMORANDUM :
TO : Imperial Japanese General Headquarters
Imperial Japanese Ministry of War
Imperial Japanese Ministry of the Navy
1. It is directed that upon the abolition of the Imperial Japanese General Headquarters, Pursuant to Memorandum dated 10 September 1945, existing liaison shall be continued between the Commanding General, Japanese First General Army and between the Commanding General, Japanese Second General Army and the Commanding General, United States Sixth Army and corresponding liaison should be continued between appropriate Japanese Naval Commanders and Commanders of the Third and Fifth United States Fleets.
2. Nothing in this memorandum or the memorandum dated 10 September 1945 shall be construed to limit or alter the obligations and requirements heretofore or hereafter imposed by directives of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
3. The Imperial Japanese Ministry of War and Imperial Japanese Ministry of the Navy will Jointly report to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers to date and hour that the above transfers of responsibility have been effected and the imperial Japanese Headquarters abolished.
4. Acknowledgement of receipt of this directive is desired.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair.
/t/ HAROLD FAIR,
Lt. Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
